items.title: A certified food protection manager is the person in charge during all hours of operation
items.evidence_hint: certified food protection manager certificates with expiry dates; manager shift schedules

items.title: The person in charge monitors handwashing, receiving, cooking, cooling, holding and sanitizing
items.evidence_hint: daily manager checklists; signed monitoring logs; food safety plan naming who verifies each step

items.title: Food employees are informed of, and report, illness symptoms and diagnoses to the person in charge
items.evidence_hint: signed employee health reporting agreements; illness reporting log; onboarding records

items.title: Employees with listed symptoms or diagnoses are excluded or restricted from food work
items.evidence_hint: exclusion and restriction log; return-to-work notes; staff schedules on the dates of reported illness

items.title: A written employee illness policy covers symptoms, diagnoses, exclusion and reinstatement
items.evidence_hint: written employee illness policy; employee handbook health section

items.title: Written procedures exist for cleaning up vomiting and diarrheal events
items.evidence_hint: vomit and diarrhea clean-up procedure; clean-up kit contents list; staff training records

items.title: Food employees wash hands for at least 20 seconds, after toilet use and between tasks
items.evidence_hint: handwashing SOP; hygiene training records; manager handwashing observation checklists

items.title: Exposed RTE food is not touched with bare hands, except under 3-301.11(D) or an approved (E) plan
items.evidence_hint: food handling SOP on gloves and utensils; regulatory approval and written procedures for any bare hand contact under 3-301.11(E)

items.title: Handwashing sinks are accessible, used only for handwashing, and have soap and towels or a dryer
items.evidence_hint: opening and closing checklists; supply restocking log; facility cleaning plan

items.title: Food comes from approved sources that comply with law, never from a private home
items.evidence_hint: approved supplier list; supplier licenses; delivery invoices

items.title: Refrigerated TCS food arrives at 5°C (41°F) or below, unless law sets another (milk, shellstock)
items.evidence_hint: receiving logs with delivery temperatures (frozen food received frozen); rejected delivery records; receiving SOP

items.title: Shellstock tags and fish parasite-destruction records are kept for 90 days
items.evidence_hint: shellstock tag file; fish freezing logs or supplier freezing statements

items.title: Raw animal foods are kept separate from ready-to-eat food in storage and preparation
items.evidence_hint: refrigerator storage order chart; food storage and preparation SOP

items.title: Food-contact surfaces are cleaned and sanitized between raw and RTE use and every 4 h with TCS food
items.evidence_hint: cleaning and sanitizing schedule (4-602.11(D) exceptions such as refrigerated prep rooms); master cleaning plan; completed cleaning checklists

items.title: Chemical sanitizer is used at its label concentration, checked with a test kit
items.evidence_hint: sanitizer concentration test logs; sanitizer product label or safety data sheet; warewashing SOP

items.title: Raw animal foods are cooked to the Code's minimum internal temperatures and times
items.evidence_hint: cooking temperature logs; recipes or HACCP plan with final cooking temperatures

items.title: Food cooked and cooled on site is reheated for hot holding to 74°C (165°F) for 15 s within 2 hours
items.evidence_hint: reheating temperature logs; reheating SOP (commercially processed, packaged RTE food: 57°C (135°F))

items.title: Cooked TCS food cools to 21°C (70°F) in 2 hours and to 5°C (41°F) within 6 hours
items.evidence_hint: cooling logs with times and temperatures; cooling SOP

items.title: Hot-held TCS food stays at 57°C (135°F) or above, or 54°C (130°F) for roasts cooked per 3-401.11(B)
items.evidence_hint: hot holding temperature logs; steam table, hot cabinet or carving station checks

items.title: Cold-held TCS food is kept at 5°C (41°F) or less
items.evidence_hint: cold holding or refrigerator temperature logs; HACCP or food safety plan

items.title: Refrigerated RTE TCS food held over 24 hours is date marked and used or discarded within 7 days
items.evidence_hint: date marking SOP and label system; discard log (exempt per 3-501.17(E)-(G): meal portions, shellstock, plant-made deli salads, hard and semi-soft cheeses, cultured dairy)

items.title: Food held under time as a public health control has written procedures and time marks
items.evidence_hint: written time-as-control procedure; time-marking labels or logs; discard records

items.title: Raw or undercooked animal foods on the menu carry a consumer advisory disclosure and reminder
items.evidence_hint: menus; menu boards; table tents or placards

items.title: Poisonous or toxic materials are labeled and stored apart from food, never above it
items.evidence_hint: chemical inventory and safety data sheets; chemical storage SOP; storage area layout

items.title: The person in charge and employees know the major food allergens and allergic reaction symptoms
items.evidence_hint: food allergy awareness training records; allergen SOP; manager certification

items.title: Consumers get written notice of major food allergens in unpackaged food
items.evidence_hint: menu allergen statements; allergen matrix or chart; signage

items.title: Food packaged on site is labeled with its ingredients and the source of each major allergen
items.evidence_hint: product labels; label templates; recipe and ingredient specifications

items.title: TCS food is thawed in the fridge, under running water at 21°C (70°F) or less, or as part of cooking
items.evidence_hint: thawing SOP; prep lists; thawing logs (3-501.13(D): any method for an RTE portion thawed for one consumer's order)

items.title: Accurate food thermometers are available and calibrated per manufacturer instructions
items.evidence_hint: thermometer calibration log; thermometer inventory

items.title: Employees are trained in food safety for their assigned duties
items.evidence_hint: training records and sign-in sheets; food handler cards; training plan

items.title: Hot-water sanitizing reaches 77°C (171°F) by manual immersion or a 71°C (160°F) utensil surface
items.evidence_hint: three-compartment sink sanitizing temperature logs; dishwasher logs or irreversible temperature indicator records

items.title: Warewashing wash solutions and the machine hot-water rinse stay within the Code temperature limits
items.evidence_hint: dishwasher temperature logs (final rinse 82-90°C, 180-194°F); manual wash at 43°C (110°F) or more; dishwasher service reports

items.title: Wet wiping cloths are held in sanitizer between uses and laundered daily
items.evidence_hint: cleaning SOP for wiping cloths; sanitizer bucket check log; laundry records

items.title: Nonfood-contact surfaces and physical facilities are cleaned as often as needed
items.evidence_hint: master cleaning schedule; completed daily and weekly cleaning checklists

items.title: The premises are kept free of pests by routine inspection and control measures
items.evidence_hint: pest control service reports; pest sighting log; delivery inspection records

items.title: Pesticides are used per label, and restricted-use pesticides only by or under a certified applicator
items.evidence_hint: pest control service reports listing products, label use and applicator license

items.title: Rodent bait is kept in covered, tamper-resistant bait stations
items.evidence_hint: pest control service reports; bait station map

items.title: Outer openings are protected against the entry of insects and rodents
items.evidence_hint: pest control report findings on entry points; maintenance work orders

items.title: Drinking water comes from an approved public or regulated non-public water system
items.evidence_hint: water utility bill or service statement; well permit for a private supply

items.title: Non-public water is tested at least annually and the latest report is kept on file
items.evidence_hint: water sample laboratory reports

items.title: Backflow is prevented by air gaps or approved devices, with no cross connections
items.evidence_hint: plumbing inspection reports; backflow preventer test certificates

items.title: Backflow preventers and water treatment devices are serviced on schedule, with records kept
items.evidence_hint: backflow test reports; water filter or softener service records

items.title: Physical facilities and equipment are maintained in good repair
items.evidence_hint: maintenance log; repair work orders and invoices; equipment service records

items.title: Sewage is disposed of through a public sewer or an approved individual system
items.evidence_hint: sewer service bill; septic system permit and pumping records

items.title: Refuse receptacles are durable, pest-resistant, leakproof, kept clean and covered when required
items.evidence_hint: waste management SOP; cleaning schedule for bins and the refuse area

items.title: Refuse is removed often enough to prevent odors and pest attraction
items.evidence_hint: waste hauler contract; pickup schedule or invoices

items.title: The establishment holds a valid operating permit, posted where consumers can see it
items.evidence_hint: food establishment permit or license with its expiry date
